Tooltip_TienCoolerIceBag: Keeps food fresh inside a cooler. Melts slowly in a cooler, quickly anywhere else, and refreezes in a powered fridge or freezer.
Tooltip_TienCoolerIceBagTainted: Frozen from tainted water. Keeps food fresh inside a cooler just as well as clean ice, but melts into tainted water that should be boiled before drinking.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_Freeze: Leave it in the powered freezer for %1 hours. Every %2 units of water becomes one bag of ice, adding up across everything you set to freeze in there.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_FreezeInBags: The water freezes a little at a time over %1 hours, filling bags of ice of %2 units each, one before the next. A bag turns up as soon as the first of it has frozen. Water set to freeze in the same freezer adds up, and water short of a full bag makes a partly filled one. Each new bag needs an empty plastic bag or garbage bag in the same freezer.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_Freezing: %1 of the %2 units needed for a bag are set to freeze in here. Ready in about %3 hours.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_FreezingRate: %1 units of water are set to freeze in here, at %2 units to a full bag of ice. All of it will be frozen in about %3 hours.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_FreezingShort: Only %1 units of water are set to freeze in here, and a bag needs %2. Set more to freeze in the same fridge and they add up; until then nothing will come of it.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_NoBags: There is water here for another bag of ice, but nothing to freeze it in. Put an empty plastic bag or garbage bag in the same freezer.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_NoPower: This refrigerator has no power. Water only freezes in one that is running.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_Catch: From now on, water from the ice melting in this cooler runs into this container until it is full. Water that melted before, or that does not fit, is lost. Ice made from tainted water melts into tainted water. Caught water can be set to freeze beside a melted bag to top it up again.
